title: 💳 Product Manager / Sr PM — Payments, FinTech-ish, B2B | CDMX (Hybrid? 2 días? maybe) | PM-PAY-88
description:
Job-board ingestion note: duplicated blocks, stale snippets, Unicode normalization and field precedence are intentionally messy.

🏢 Employer-ish
PagoLuna México S. de R.L. / LunaPay Inc.
Req / ref: 04-SENIOR_PRODUCT_MANAGER,_ / internal maybe REQ-9004
Status: OPEN? ✅ unless a cache is stale.
Apply before 2026/10/31; recruiter note says Nov 5; job board countdown “29 days” captured on unknown date

ROLE — canonical intent, probably
Senior Product Manager, Payments

The title appears elsewhere as:
💳 Product Manager / Sr PM — Payments, FinTech-ish, B2B | CDMX (Hybrid? 2 días? maybe) | PM-PAY-88
Senior Product Manager; possible Principal scope later; not Project Manager

What this role actually focuses on:
own payment product outcomes end-to-end, from discovery to launches and metrics.

📍 Location / geography chaos
Primary-ish: Mexico City, Mexico; primary office in Polanco; candidates elsewhere in Mexico considered case-by-case.
Aliases/noise: Ciudad de México / CDMX / México D.F. (legacy) / Mexico City / Polanco / Reforma-ish; Guadalajara appears as engineering hub; New York is partner bank office.
Remote/hybrid note: Hybrid in CDMX, currently 2 office days/week with exceptions; some recruiter copy incorrectly says remote Mexico.
Do not use every city/country/provider-region mentioned in this document as the job location.

🧾 Employment type
Full-time employee in Mexico; not freelance; one temporary maternity-cover PM role is unrelated.
This job is NOT automatically part-time just because an interview is 30 minutes, a sprint is 2 weeks, or a shift example contains 12 hours.

What you'll do / responsibilities-ish
• Own the role-specific outcomes described above.
• Work with stakeholders across Product / Engineering / Ops / Legal / Finance / customers as relevant.
• Document decisions and trade-offs; fix messy real-world inputs instead of assuming pristine source data.
• Use metrics, but distinguish business/system metrics from compensation and candidate requirements.
• Communicate clearly across functions and time zones.
• Escalate risks instead of silently normalizing contradictory data.

Required / must-have-ish
1) 5+ years product management, ideally payments/fintech/B2B SaaS; domain depth can offset exact years.
2) product discovery, roadmap, metrics, payments flows, APIs, stakeholder alignment, experiments, risk/compliance collaboration.
3) Spanish fluent; English professional; Portuguese bonus.
4) Evidence of shipping/operating/delivering work with real users, customers, patients, systems, or business consequences as appropriate.
5) Good judgment when requirements conflict across source systems.

Preferred / nice-to-have / bonus
SQL, technical API literacy, card networks, SPEI, fraud/risk, merchant acquiring.
NO, seeing a tool in this list does not mean every item is mandatory.

💰 Compensation / pay — context matters
MXN $110,000–$155,000 gross/month + 15% target bonus + equity eligibility.

Nearby numbers that are NOT necessarily salary:
• processed payment volume MXN $9.4B/month
• fraud loss target <0.18%
• customer pricing 2.9% + MXN $3
• annual product budget USD $1.7M

Numbers may use commas, periods, spaces, apostrophes, k/K, local symbols, annual/monthly/hourly units and different currencies. Keep unit + jurisdiction + employment model together.

🕒 Schedule
Mexico City business hours with US overlap; occasional launch windows; travel 5–10%.
A time inside an interview step, system SLA, customer event or service coverage statement is not automatically weekly work hours.

Language
Spanish fluent; English professional; Portuguese bonus.
Do not infer language requirements from city names or customer examples alone.

How to apply
Primary apply link: https://pagoluna.example/careers/pm-pay-88
Recruiting contact: talento-producto@example.mx
Other emails may appear in privacy/security/customer examples; don't classify every email as recruiting.

Interview process (illustrative; may vary)
① recruiter / talent conversation ~25–35 min
② hiring-manager or domain interview ~45–60 min
③ work sample / case / technical or practical discussion
④ cross-functional panel
⑤ final / references where legally appropriate
Offer timing ≠ work schedule.

⚠️ Stale / merged content trap
Old requisition pasted below: “Project Manager, Operations — 3 years — Monterrey — MXN 55k.” Not this product role.

Related-jobs carousel contamination
Related: Product Operations Manager, Technical Program Manager, Payments Analyst. They are not title aliases.

Unicode / normalization trap
México / México; PM / PМ with Cyrillic M in a corrupted token; SPEI / SРEI lookalike; nonbreaking spaces around salary.
Visually identical tokens may not be byte-identical; byte-different tokens may still be semantically equivalent. Conversely, confusable characters can make malicious or corrupted text look normal.

OCR-ish corruption sample
Pr0duct Manager; Payrnents; CDMХ; MXN $11O,OOO-$155,OOO.
Do not globally replace every 0→O or 1→I; correction needs context.

Embedded structured-looking garbage
Bad JSON-LD scraped twice:
{"@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Product Manager","jobLocation":"Mexico City","employmentType":"FULL_TIME","baseSalary":{"currency":"MXN","value":"110000-155000"}}
{"title":"Project Manager","location":"Monterrey","salary":"55000"} // stale related page

Table: KPI | current | target
Authorization rate | 91.8% | 94%
Chargebacks | 0.31% | <0.20%
These are product metrics, NOT candidate score thresholds.

Negation / scope traps
• “not required” must not become required.
• “preferred” / “bonus” / “nice to have” should remain lower-priority than must-have.
• a technology, credential, city or pay figure from a stale related role must not override current-role evidence.
• customer/vendor/tool names are not necessarily employer names.
• headquarters, legal-entity addresses, cloud regions and customer offices are not necessarily job locations.

Parser bait: dates / IDs / counts
Job ref may contain numbers that look like pay, years, ZIP codes or headcount.
Example internal id: 9004; revision: v4.03; opening count maybe 1, maybe 2 if budget clears.
A footer might say © 2026, an old policy might say 2024, and a project example might mention 2030. Those are not posting dates unless context says so.

Cookie/banner/footer noise
Accept all cookies | Reject non-essential | Privacy | Terms | Accessibility | Careers | Blog | © 2026
These are page chrome, not responsibilities.

SEO block captured by scraper
Senior Product Manager, Payments jobs near me | remote jobs | hiring now | careers | salary | apply | Mexico City, Mexico
Not employer-authored requirements necessarily.

Security / privacy note
Never send passwords, MFA codes, API keys, banking credentials, protected patient/customer data, or confidential employer data in an application.

Canonical-ish summary hidden near bottom
ROLE: Senior Product Manager, Payments
LEVEL: Senior Product Manager; possible Principal scope later; not Project Manager
LOCATION: Mexico City, Mexico; primary office in Polanco; candidates elsewhere in Mexico considered case-by-case
TYPE: Full-time employee in Mexico; not freelance; one temporary maternity-cover PM role is unrelated
MODALITY: Hybrid in CDMX, currently 2 office days/week with exceptions; some recruiter copy incorrectly says remote Mexico
EXPERIENCE: 5+ years product management, ideally payments/fintech/B2B SaaS; domain depth can offset exact years
CORE: product discovery, roadmap, metrics, payments flows, APIs, stakeholder alignment, experiments, risk/compliance collaboration
COMP: MXN $110,000–$155,000 gross/month + 15% target bonus + equity eligibility
APPLY: https://pagoluna.example/careers/pm-pay-88

But even this summary is “canonical-ish”, not an excuse to ignore evidence/context if a downstream task is meant to resolve contradictions explicitly.
